spec.name: Reversal v20
spec.notes: Short-horizon reversal: buy yesterday's losers, sell the winners.

claim.text: Research-period backtest: Sharpe 1.7, annual return 5%, maximum drawdown 3%.

exhibits.summary: On the sealed period, traded as live (strict data, 10 bps, at least one bar of lag), the Sharpe ratio is 1.29 against 1.70 in research, a gap of +0.40.
The log holds 3 distinct specs; the best of 3 under no edge is expected to reach a Sharpe of 0.15, so the claimed 1.70 becomes 1.55 and the probability that the true Sharpe is above zero is 100%.
The real signal's gross Sharpe of 5.06 beats 100% of 200 shuffled signals (shuffled mean 0.04, 95th percentile 0.56).
Perturbing the 1 numeric value in the signal by up to 50% moves the Sharpe ratio from 1.70 to as low as 1.50 (as low as 1.50 at 25%).
On the full universe the Sharpe ratio is 1.70 against 1.70 as submitted; the strategy never saw 0 delisted assets.

Delaying the signal by 1 more bar moves the Sharpe ratio from 1.70 to -4.08 (change -5.77). The strategy already trades a bar after its signal, so this measures how fast the signal fades, not look-ahead.

verdict.opinion: The strategy's performance is supported by multiple exhibits, including a placebo test showing statistical significance and no evidence of lookahead bias. The holdout test shows a slight drop in Sharpe ratio, but it is within expected ranges. No charges were filed, and the strategy appears valid for deployment.
